title: Senate passes short-term bill to prevent a shutdown before the midterm elections
script: Here is what viewers need to know right now. The key update now being reported is: Senate passes short-term bill to prevent a shutdown before the midterm elections. In simple words, WASHINGTON — The Senate voted 90-6 early Saturday to pass a short-term funding bill to remove the threat of a government shutdown before the midterm elections Some details may change as more information becomes available, so viewers should check trusted news sources for the newest update. We will continue watching for clearer and more reliable updates.
